description: The website 'debug-practice.test' is currently down with a 500 Internal Server Error immediately after a configuration change. Your task is to diagnose the issue using Virtualmin's logs or file manager, identify the syntax error in the site's .htaccess file, and fix it. You must preserve the existing redirection logic (redirecting /old-page to new-page.php) while fixing the syntax error that is crashing the server.
